content: Tipamender Petrus ziru Yoan
Petrus ziru Yoan tizzo sua pizin tomtom, mi zin patoronŋana kan pakan ziŋan biibi kizin menderŋan ta timborro Urum Merere i, mi zin sadusi pakan timar.
Timar raama keten malmal kat pa Petrus ziru Yoan. Pa ziru tikamam sua pizin tomtom mi tizzo ta kembei: Wal ta so tisekap la ki Yesu, nako timaŋga mini pa naala.
Mi rorou kek. Tana tila ma tikiskis zin, mi tiur zin lela ruumu sanaana pataaŋa be tinaama sua. Ziru be timbot tana, mi tikeene ma aigule toro.
Mi zin tomtom tau tileŋ sua kizin na, boozomen tiurla. Tabe tila tigaaba zin ta muŋguŋan na, to zan isala kat. Zin tomtom tirao kembei munŋaana lamata (5,000).
Aigule toro na, zin peeze kan kizin Yuda, ziŋan zin mboroŋan mi zin ŋgarŋan ki tutu tilup zin su Yerusalem.
Mi bibip kizin wal patoronŋana kan ta Anas, Kaipas, Yoan, mi Alisande na, mi wal kizin pakan, ziŋan tau.
Timbotmbot, mi tikam Petrus ziru Yoan ma timar na, tipamender ziru ila keren uunu. To tiwi zin ma tiso: “Ai, niomru kakam uraata ti pa asiŋ zaana mi mburaana?”
To Bubuŋana Potomŋana izeebe Petrus, mi imaŋga to iso pizin. Iso: “Niom peeze koyom mi niom mboroŋan.
Parei? Koozi niom kosombe kiwi yam pa mbulu ambaiŋana tau ipet pa tomtom kaamaŋana ti, mi zaala tau ni niini ambai, ta koboobo yam i?

Nakena niom ta boozomen keleŋ kat. Mi niom men som. Zin Israel ta munŋaana men. Iŋgi kosa sa som. Mi Yesu Krisi ki Nasaret ta kupuni ma imeete sala ke pambaaraŋana, mi Anutu ipei i ma burup ma imaŋga pa naala na. Ina ni zaana mi mburaana, ta ikam ma niom kere tomtom kaamaŋana taiŋgi niini ambai mi imendernder la motoyom i.
Yesu ta muŋgu tibeede ka sua ta kembei:

content.text: Pat ta niom wal tau kowwo ruumu na, motoyom repiili mi kipiri lae lene na, pat tamen tana, ta ko tipamender ruumu sala ma imbol.

content: “Ni itutamen ta ulaaŋa kiti. Sombe turu ulaaŋa la ki tomtom toro sa, ina tarao tendeeŋe som. Pa tomtom ta tirao toono ti, na sa zaana irao iuulu kat iti ma tombot ndabok na som. Pa Anutu iur ni itutamen.”
Timbotmbot mi tire Petrus ziru Yoan timoto som mi tizzo katkat sua, to timurur pizin. Pa tiute zin tomtom kar kan men. Tila skul biibi som. Tana tikilaala zin kembei ziŋan Yesu tiwwa tau.
Mi tire tomtom ta tiurpe i ma niini ambai i, ziŋan timender ma timbotmbot, tabe len sua sa som mi timaane men.
To tiser Petrus ziru Yoan pa lupŋana kizin ma tipera mat, mi zin be tiso kan sua.

Mi timaŋga na tiparwi zin. Tiso: “Lak, iŋgi kozo ko takam parei pizin? Pa mos biibi ta ziru tikam na, ina ipet kat mat, mi iwal biibi ta timbot Yerusalem i tiute lup kek. Tana iti tosombe takam be tawatkaala, nako takam ma tarao som.
Mi bela tupunmeete sua tiŋgi ma imborene kat. Kokena irak ma wal pakan tileŋ mi tiurla. Kozo takam sua pamotoŋana pizin mi tepeteke zin be tiso sua pa tomtom sa pa Yesu zaana mini pepe.”
Tiso makiŋ, to tiboobo Petrus ziru Yoan ma tile mini na, kwon imbol pizin be tikam sua sa pizin tomtom pa Yesu zaana mini pepe.
Tamen ziru tipekel ma tiso: “Wai, kena niom ituyom kitiiri. Ko parei? Amleŋ la niom kalŋoyom, som Anutu kalŋaana? Mbulu iŋgoi ta indeeŋe pa Anutu mataana?
Pa koroŋ biibi ta niam amre mi amleŋ kek. Tana iŋgi irao amaane na som. Ko amzzo men ta kembei.”

Tiso ta kembei, tabe zin bibip tisu ma tise pizin, mi tikam sua pamotoŋana pizin mini. Mana tizem zin ma tila. Tana zin bibip tana tiru zaala be tiseeze matan ma som. Pa iwal timap tire uraata tana ma lelen ambai mi tipakur Anutu pa.
Pa tomtom kaamaŋana ta mos tana ipet pini ma niini ndabok na, ndaama kini ilip pa tomtooru kek.
Suŋŋana kizin wal urlaŋana kan
Petrus ziru Yoan tiyooto na, kaŋkaŋ ma tila ki waen bizin, mi tiso zin pa sua ta zin bibip kizin patoronŋana kan mi zin mboroŋan tikam pizin na.

To waen bizin tileŋ na, tilup lelen mi tikam suŋŋana ila ki Anutu ta kembei. Tiso: “O Merere, nu ta mburom keskeezeŋom mi koroŋ imap katuunu. Nu ur saamba mi toono, mi tai raama koroŋ boozomen men ta timbot pa.
Itum Bubuŋom Potomŋana ta ikam peeze pa tumbuyam Dabit ta mbesooŋo ku na, ma iso ta kembei:

content.text: Parei ta zin karkari keten malmal mi kalŋan izalla?
Wal matan munŋan timburmbuuru sorok paso?
Zin king ki toono ziŋan zin peeze kan tilup zin,
mi tikam kumbun be ziŋan Merere mi Mesia kini tiporou.

content: “Mi iŋgi sua tiŋgi iur ŋonoono kek. Pa nu itum roogo mbesooŋo ku potomŋana Yesu, mi uri ma iwe Mesia. Tamen Erot ziru Pilatus ziŋan zin wal ta Yuda somŋan i mi zin Israel, ta tilup zin su kar biibi ti mi tipuni ma imeete.
Mi timaŋga ma tikam mbulu ti na, itoptop la zaala tau nu itum lelem iur pa pataaŋa kek be ipet ta kembena.
Merere, sua pamotoŋana ta tikamam piam i, nu leŋ kek. Tana pombol niam mbesooŋo ku be amoto pepe, mibe amender mbolŋana pa sua ku kamŋana.
Swe mburom mi urpe zin meteŋan mi kam mos bibip pakan ma ipet pa mbesooŋo ku potomŋana Yesu zaana.”
Tisuŋ makiŋ, to kembei ta yeŋyeeŋge itok pa lele tau tilup zin pa i, mi Bubuŋana Potomŋana izeebe zin ta boozomen. Tana timoto som, mi timender mbolŋana pa Anutu sua kini soyaaraŋana.
Zin urlaŋana kan tiparlup lelen
Zin urlaŋana kan ta munŋaana men lelen mi ŋgar kizin iwe tamen. Mi tomtom sa irao kwoono mbol pa koroŋ kini sa be iwe itutamen lene i som. Koroŋ kizin ta munŋaana men, ta tiparrai pizin men.
Mi uraata kizin ŋgoŋana ta tipombolmbol sua pa maŋgaŋana ki Merere Yesu na, mburaana biibi. Mi kampeŋana biibi imbotmbot raama zin urlaŋana kan ta boozomen.
Mi tomtom kizin sa imbot ŋoobo som. Pa zin ta len toono mi ruumu na, tiurur ŋgomo pa. Beso tikam ka pat,
to tikam ma tiur la kizin ŋgoŋana. Toinabe zin tirai pizin wal tau len koroŋ som mi timbot ŋoobo i.

Tikamam ta kembei, tana tomtom ta ki mutu Saiprus, zaana Yosep, ni tomini iur ŋgomo pa toono kini. To tiŋgiimi, mi ikam ka pat ma ila iur la kizin ŋgoŋana. Yosep tana, ni uunu ipet la ki Lebi. Mi zin ŋgoŋana tileele zaana be Panabas. (Pisis Panabas ka uunu ta kembei: ‘Tomtom ki ipombolmbol zin tomtom’.)
